response.description: The Production Touch Ledger (PTL) Assessment Report is now available. Capgemini, an independent third party, has validated the design of PTL for its ability to preserve the completeness, tamper-evidence, and non-repudiation of production-access records. This provides customers with independent assessment of PTL’s capabilities rather than solely relying on Microsoft’s claims. PTL, launched with phased rollout in the EU Data Boundary, provides organizations a verifiable record of when and how Microsoft personnel access the in-scope production systems that host their workloads. Every access record is written to Azure Confidential Ledger, making the record tamper-evident: once an entry is recorded, any attempt to alter or remove it can be detected. Security, compliance, and risk teams can use the PTL Assessment Report as independent evidence in regulatory reviews, internal audits, and customer access conversations.Learn more:Download the Assessment ReportProduction Touch Ledger Documentation
